claim: A door that rises (type 600) sounds like what its leaf is made of, as the campaign's ceiling doors wearing that tile do: a wooden leaf (22) most often pairs start 110 with stop 160 (4 doors), starts on 105 more often over all (9 across three tuples) and never on 106; panelled metal (495) starts most on 111 and stops on 169 (6) or 165 (4); stone (110, 1011) starts on 106. Stone's 106 on a wooden door sounds like moving stone.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-23: 'These wooden zdoor sound 106 sounds like a moving stone ... example 110 would be better' (projects/blood-city/level/motion_sounds.py:57-58 keeps it whole; projects/blood-city/tests/test_city_sounds.py:37 quotes its first half)
